name: @pryzm/plugin-pool
description: PRYZM — Swimming-pool plugin (L-292 / ADR-0124). A pool is an ASSEMBLY, not a primitive: pool.create composes a HOLE in the host slab + N pool WALLS (real Wall records, negative baseOffset) + a pool FLOOR (a real Slab) + the WATER, in ONE undo entry via produceMultiStoreCommand. pool.delete removes all of it AND heals the hole. Geometry math lives in @pryzm/geometry-pool (pure).
